lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately four to five visible horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-grid pattern posterior to the gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a distinct lattice or checkerboard pattern typical of the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, deep V-shaped notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the right pectoral fin, indicating loss of tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple commensal organisms (Echeneidae) is visible attached to the ventral surface and following the slipstream of the pectoral fin.
